Widely celebrated as one of the most historically important countries for its contributions to art, culture, science, and modern civilization, Italy comprises some of the world’s most beautiful and noteworthy cities. Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16 highlights nine urban areas throughout Italy, ranging from the country’s north to its southern tip, including the islands of Sardinia and Sicily. The areas covered include coastal cities, inland metropolitan regions, and urban areas set to dramatic natural backdrops. 

Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16: Italy is available to all owners of Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 today for FREE. author: XBOX
description:
25 years got us here. 

Pre-order the XBOX Series X25 Limited Edition console and the XBOX Controller X25 Special Edition. Inspired by one of the most iconic XBOX console designs in our 25-year history, it’s now reimagined for XBOX Series X with the full power of a modern console experience. 

Finished in translucent OG green, it features a new “X” animation that lights up green when you power it on, along with the “XBOX 25” mark. This is XBOX in a way you’ve never seen before. Part throwback. Part what’s next. All in one. Coming November 2026 for XBOX 25th anniversary. 

The XBOX Controller X25 Special Edition packs 25 years of design into every detail. For the first time, see through the back case and battery door, revealing the classic XBOX logo. Original-color ABXY buttons bring the past forward, while the green XBOX button calls back to the moment the first green “X” burst onto the scene. Coming October 2026. 

Pre-order now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles/xbox-series-x#x25limited
title: Pre-Order the XBOX 25th Anniversary Collection
